source.institution: Central Institute of Educational Technology (CIET), NCERT
source.title: Barkhaa Audio

mundari_manifestations.catalogue_observation: The current first-party Barkhaa Audio page explicitly lists Mundari among the available language labels for each of these nine Level-1 titles.
mundari_manifestations.negative_boundary_observation: Tota is listed at Level 1 but the inspected current catalogue text does not expose a Mundari label for that title.

rights_and_governance.rule: Catalogue availability is an exact manifestation locator only; it is not treated as blanket reuse permission, participant consent, community validation, or cultural-access authorization.

promotion.reason: Exact title-level audio manifestations are verified at the first-party catalogue layer, but individual media bytes, reuse rights and participant/community/cultural governance remain unresolved.

remaining_gap: Resolve individual audio file locators/bytes/hashes and explicit reuse/consent/community/cultural-access boundaries before content-level promotion.
